summary: OpenAI released MRC, a new networking protocol for large-scale AI training clusters, via the Open Compute Project to improve resilience and performance.

mechanisms.reason: A new protocol aimed at improving networking resilience and performance in large training clusters implies increased demand for advanced interconnect fabric.
